text_block_list.text:
Lately, playing dodgeball during lunch 
break has become a trend among the 
students. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want me to join Blast's team?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! We're having a league match 
soon! Everyone's getting so much better, 
it's definitely gonna be a fierce contest!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... That sounds fun! Mind if I join 
in?"

And so, Blast Onepiece's team, now joined 
by Almond Eye, was set to enter the league 
matches, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she caught it midair and threw it 
back?! That's our Ai!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We're going to keep pressing the attack! 
Team Woof-Woof, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Ai-san was seriously amazing in 
yesterday's match!" "We've definitely got 
a shot at winning the league!"

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Even though they call it a league 
match, it's just for fun, yet before I 
knew it, everyone got dead serious.

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Ai-san isn't fair. Her talent is 
just on another level. Whatever she does, 
she naturally ends up at the top... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ai-san? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's independent practice. Ever since I 
started dodgeball, I've been using this 
place every day, fitting it in between my 
training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
E-Every day...? It's just a game, so why 
go that far... Isn't it enough to just 
take it easy and have fun?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? But they're all strong teams, so 
wouldn't it be even more exciting if we 
won?"

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
...! S-So full of confidence...! You can 
only say that because you're able to do 
anything...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. In fact, I've been 
practicing since yesterday, and there's 
something I haven't been able to do at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Your passes are always so 
accurate. Would you mind teaching me how 
you do it?

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text: Eh... Huh? Me, to Ai-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If possible, to everyone on the team 
too. Please!

And so—the match began for the team that 
had kept on racking up wins, with the 
championship on the line.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, sorry, everyone! I ended up getting 
hit!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! Leave the 
infield to us! Let's get those points back 
with teamwork!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Not gonna happen. Everyone, mark Ai-san 
thoroughly. We're taking down both of the 
team's wings.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...! Gah...! They've been 
relentlessly targeting me this whole 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text: ...! Ai-san, look out!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-You... protected me...!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
"...That's no good! If either you or 
Blast-san don't stay on the court, we'll 
be totally checkmated...!"

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
"Winning makes it even more fun. ...That's 
how it works, isn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

And from there—the team showed incredible 
coordination and seized the championship!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I really did it!! We're the 
champions~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai totally nailed it at the end! You were 
so cool, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But that was all thanks to 
Blast giving me that pinpoint pass back 
then. And thanks to everyone executing the 
tactics properly.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is a victory grasped by our entire 
team!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Halfway through, we were all practicing on 
our own together! Boo's never gonna forget 
that time!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't forget it either. Beating a 
strong opponent, overcoming a wall through 
sheer effort... is the best feeling in the 
world!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If you truly feel that way... then 
I, too, am truly glad that I came to this 
team.

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ai-san is truly the captain of this 
team!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
All right! In that case, everyone, let's 
celebrate the victory and toss the Captain 
into the air!

The whole team tossed Almond Eye into the 
air, celebrating their victory.
